# Focus Ring

The visible focus indicator, and what clips or hides one by accident.

In `library/components/focus-ring/` — copy `component.{html,css}`, read `docs.md` for why.

## Keyboard

- `Tab` — :focus-visible matches this; :focus also matches a mouse press

**States:** focus-visible, focus

## Goes wrong when

- outline:none with no equal-or-better replacement (SC 2.4.7)
- an overflow:hidden ancestor clipping a positive outline-offset, with nothing to see
- border-radius in a focus rule — an outline already follows the element’s own
- a sticky bar covering the focused element, which only happens moving backwards (SC 2.4.11)
- a ring built out of the border, which a ghost button does not have at rest

WCAG 1.4.1 1.4.11 2.4.7 2.4.11 2.4.13 · see also `skip-link`, `button`, `effects`
